name: imprimatur
description: See every doc edit your AI agent makes as tracked changes until you accept it: Claude Code hooks that record each edit and what the agent waits on you for, and an MCP server for tasks and records. Pair it with the Imprimatur VS Code extension (npm run setup -- --plugin).

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of model-written edit descriptions, e.g. Turkish. Empty: the agent's own. Waiting on you follows Reply language.

reply_language.title: Reply language
reply_language.description: Language the agent replies to you in, in every repo, e.g. Turkish. Empty: English (or config.json from npm run setup -- --reply-lang).

extensions.title: File extensions
extensions.description: Comma-separated extensions whose edits are tracked. Empty: md,mdx (or config.json from npm run setup -- --exts).
